interaction: On a stylised riverside park map with 24 stall pins, Food / Makers / Music / Vegan filters make matching pins glow; tapping a pin (or a list entry) opens what the stall sells, where it is and sample prices, and 'Add to my night' builds a reorderable list while a lantern-gold walking path draws between the stops in order, with an illustrative walking distance.
notes: Fictional market; stalls, prices, programme and line-up are samples. The walking distance is illustrative. The stallholder form ends in a demo state — nothing is sent. On phones the map rotates to a portrait layout.
